subject: Inputs updated by javascript do not reach server.R

messages.author: c2959b3cda9ef153
messages.subject: Inputs updated by javascript do not reach server.R
parts:
Hello,

I have an application with two dates, where the second is equal to the first one by default (however, you can change it). In the interface, the second date updates perfectly but the value is not correctly passed to server.R when I hit the button. I  suspect that somewhere a 

Shiny.onInputChange() is missing, but cannot figure out where

The debugger shows no errors

Below you will see part of my index.html. The rest is irrelevant




<script type="text/javascript">
  function updateinput(){
  var input_value = document.getElementById("date1_input").value;
  
  document.getElementById("date2_input").value = input_value;
  }
  </script>



<div style="position:absolute;top:50px;left:50px" id="date1" class="shiny-date-input">
    <label class="control-label" for="date1">Date 1</label>
    <input  id="date1_input" onchange=updateinput() type="text" class="input-medium datepicker" data-date-language="en" data-date-weekstart="0" data-date-format="yyyy-mm-dd" data-date-start-view="month" data-initial-date="2015-01-20"/>
  </div>

<div id="date2" class="shiny-date-input">
    <input type="text" id="date2_input" class="input-medium datepicker" data-date-language="en" data-date-weekstart="0" data-date-format="yyyy-mm-dd" data-date-start-view="month" data-initial-date="2015-01-30"/>
  </div>

<div>
          <button style="position:absolute;bottom:150px;left:200px" id="run" type="button" class="btn action-button shiny-bound-input" >Run</button>
        </div>


I have done some tries with Shiny.onInputChange() but none of them has worked out. input$date2 keeps sticking to the initial-date

Thank you!!

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Inputs updated by javascript do not reach server.R
parts:
Adding one or both of these lines might be necessary:

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/blob/424696cf963439eb9441fc60e2542642a1651cbb/inst/www/shared/shiny.js#L1942

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/blob/424696cf963439eb9441fc60e2542642a1651cbb/inst/www/shared/shiny.js#L1989

Note that you'll need to replace `$(el)` with the proper jQuery selector for the date input object - I think it should be `$('date2')`.

-Winston
